reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 10 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Thunder (confidence).
Bottom line: the Thunder win 80 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.
